mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in a month and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 2 consecutive months and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% MoM and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) decreases, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE > 5% and PAYEMS decreases, but 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based demand slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST and RSAFS both decrease, but 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% signals heightened tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% during a tightening cycle and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
